xna-type.name: IndirectPositionCollection
xna-type.summary: Provides methods for maintaining a list of vertex positions.
xna-type.syntax: public sealed class IndirectPositionCollection : IList<Vector3>, ICollection<Vector3>, IEnumerable<Vector3>, IEnumerable
xna-type.remarks: This class is designed to collect the vertex positions for a VertexContent object. Use the contents of the PositionIndices property (of the contained VertexContent object) to index into the Positions property of the parent mesh.

property.name: Count
property.summary: Number of positions in the collection.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Gets or sets the position at the specified index.

method.name: Contains
method.summary: Determines whether the specified position is in the collection.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified position is in the collection.

parameters.parameter: Position being searched for in the collection.

overload.returns: true if the position was found; false otherwise.

method.name: CopyTo
method.summary: Copies the specified positions to an array, starting at the specified index.

overload.summary: Copies the specified positions to an array, starting at the specified index.

parameters.parameter: Array of positions to be copied.
Index of the first copied position.

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Gets an enumerator interface for reading the position values.

overload.summary: Gets an enumerator interface for reading the position values.
overload.returns: Interface for enumerating the collection of position values.

method.name: IndexOf
method.summary: Gets the index of the specified position in a collection.

overload.summary: Gets the index of the specified position in a collection.
